name: Google Calendar

steps.note: saves from the event details page

tips: Shortcuts work only after they are turned on: Settings > tick "Enable keyboard shortcuts" > Save.
Press ? to see every shortcut. The help page lists j or n for the next date range but no key for the previous one; read it from the ? list.
Views have two keys each: 1 or d (day), 2 or w (week), 3 or m (month), 4 or x (custom), 5 or a (agenda).
delete_event acts on the selected event; Backspace does the same. z undoes the last change.
mod+s saves only from the event details page, and Escape returns from that page to the calendar grid.
The Keep and Tasks side panel is reached with Ctrl+Alt+. or , on Windows, Cmd+Option+. or , on Mac, and Alt+Shift+. or , on a Chromebook.
